questions.question_text: A joint family has a father, a mother, three married sons, and one unmarried daughter. Two sons each have two daughters; the third has one son. How many female members are in the family?
questions.explanation: Count the mother (1), unmarried daughter (1), wives of the three married sons (3), and four granddaughters (4): 1+1+3+4=9. The grandson and male family members do not add to the female count.
questions.source: Blood relation 02_.pdf, lecture slide 5; exam/year not stated; wording clarified from bilingual slide

questions.question_text: F is the brother of G. G is the husband of H. H is the daughter of I, and I is the wife of J. How is F related to J?
questions.explanation: I is J's wife and H is I's daughter, so H is J's daughter. G is H's husband and F is G's brother. Thus F is the brother of J's daughter's husband.
questions.source: Blood relation 02_.pdf, lecture slide 8; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Himmat is the husband of Kavita. Sharda is the daughter of Ravi and Ketaki, and Kavita and Sharda are full sisters. How is Ravi related to Himmat?
questions.explanation: Ravi is Sharda's father. Since Kavita and Sharda are full sisters, Ravi is also Kavita's father. Himmat is Kavita's husband, so Ravi is Himmat's father-in-law.
questions.source: Blood relation 02_.pdf, lecture slide 10; exam/year not stated; full-sibling relation stated explicitly

questions.question_text: H is the husband of G. J is H's son. L is J's son. L and M are full siblings. N is M's mother and is married to J. How is N related to H?
questions.explanation: N is married to J, who is H's son. Therefore N is H's daughter-in-law. The full-sibling statement also makes N L's mother, consistent with the slide's family chain.
questions.source: Blood relation 02_.pdf, lecture slide 11; exam/year not stated; marriage and full-sibling links stated to remove ambiguity

questions.question_text: Kartik is the paternal grandfather of Deepak. Nirupama is Deepak's mother, and Ankit is both Nirupama's husband and Deepak's father. How is Kartik related to Ankit?
questions.explanation: Ankit is Deepak's father. Kartik is Deepak's paternal grandfather, so Kartik is the father of Ankit.
questions.source: Blood relation 02_.pdf, lecture slide 12; exam/year not stated; Ankit's parentage of Deepak made explicit

questions.question_text: Karishma introduces Reshma and says, ‘She is my father-in-law's daughter's daughter.’ How is Reshma related to Karishma?
questions.explanation: Karishma's father-in-law's daughter is her husband's sister. That daughter's daughter is Karishma's niece.
questions.source: Blood relation 02_.pdf, lecture slide 13; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A+B: A is the son of B; A−B: A is the sister of B; A×B: A is the wife of B; A÷B: A is the father of B. Assume the stated parents are spouses. How is Q related to D in Q÷E+R−C×D?
questions.explanation: Q is E's father and R is E's other parent, so Q and R are spouses. R is C's sister, and C is D's wife. Therefore Q is the husband of D's wife's sister.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 4; exam/year not stated; co-parent spouse assumption made explicit

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A+B: A is the sister of B; A−B: A is the brother of B; A×B: A is the wife of B; A÷B: A is the father of B. Assume sibling links denote full siblings. How is F related to Y in F−H×L÷O+Y?
questions.explanation: F is H's brother; H is L's wife. L is O's father, and O is Y's sister, so O and Y share parents. H is their mother; F is their mother's brother.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 6; exam/year not stated; full-sibling relation stated

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A%B: A is the daughter of B; A$B: A is the son of B; A*B: A is the sister of B. How is H related to J in H%I$J$K*L?
questions.explanation: H is the daughter of I, and I is the son of J. Thus H is J's granddaughter.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 7; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A+B: A is the father of B; A−B: A is the sister of B; A×B: A is the brother of B; A÷B: A is the daughter of B. Assume sibling links denote full siblings. How is S related to U in R+S×T−V÷U?
questions.explanation: R is S's father. S is T's brother, T is V's sister, and V is U's daughter. Under the stated full-sibling convention, S is also U's child; since S is identified as a brother, S is U's son.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 8; exam/year not stated; full-sibling relation stated

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A+B: A is the sister of B; A@B: A is the brother of B; A#B: A is the wife of B; A÷B: A is the father of B. Assume stated sibling links denote full siblings. How is W related to U in W@E+R÷H#U?
questions.explanation: W is E's brother and E is R's sister, so W is R's brother. R is H's father; H is U's wife. Therefore W is the brother of U's wife's father.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 9; exam/year not stated; full-sibling relation stated

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A$B: A is the son of B; A+B: A is the brother of B; A@B: A is the wife of B; A÷B: A is the father of B. Assume sibling links denote full siblings. How is E related to N in E$F÷G+M@N?
questions.explanation: E is F's son and F is G's father, so E and G are siblings. G is M's brother, so E is M's brother. M is N's wife; hence E is N's wife's brother.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 11; exam/year not stated; sibling links clarified

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A+B: A is the daughter of B; A−B: A is the brother of B; A×B: A is the wife of B; A÷B: A is the father of B. Assume O and P are full siblings. How is M related to Q in M÷N×O−P+Q?
questions.explanation: M is N's father; N is O's wife. O is P's brother, and P is Q's daughter, so O is Q's son. Therefore M is the father of Q's son's wife.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 12; exam/year not stated; full-sibling link stated

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A+B: B is the father of A; A#B: B is the sister of A; A@B: B is the brother of A. Assume the sibling links denote full siblings. How is E related to A in A@B#C+D+E?
questions.explanation: B is A's brother and C is B's sister, so A, B, and C are siblings. D is C's father and E is D's father. E is two generations above A, so E is A's grandfather.
questions.source: Blood relation 03_.pdf, lecture slide 17; exam/year not stated; full-sibling relation stated

questions.question_text: Rita is the sister of Mohan. Mohan is the father of Kiran. How is Rita related to Kiran?
questions.explanation: Rita is the sister of Kiran's father, so she is Kiran's paternal aunt.

questions.question_text: Asha is the daughter of Neha. Neha is the daughter of Lata. How is Lata related to Asha?
questions.explanation: Neha is Asha's mother, and Lata is Neha's mother. Lata is Asha's maternal grandmother.

questions.question_text: Pointing to a boy, Meena says, ‘He is the son of my father's only son.’ Meena has one brother, and her father has no other sons. How is the boy related to Meena?
questions.explanation: Meena's father's only son is her brother. The boy is her brother's son, so he is her nephew.

questions.question_text: P is the father of Q. Q and R are full siblings. How is P related to R?
questions.explanation: P is Q's father, and R is Q's full sibling. Therefore P is also R's father.

questions.question_text: Asha is the daughter of Ravi. Ravi is the son of Mohan. How is Mohan related to Asha?
questions.explanation: Ravi is Asha's father. Mohan is Ravi's father, so Mohan is Asha's paternal grandfather.

questions.question_text: Tara is the daughter of Arjun and Meera. Rohit is Tara's son. How is Arjun related to Rohit?
questions.explanation: Arjun is Tara's father, and Tara is Rohit's mother. Arjun is Rohit's maternal grandfather.

questions.question_text: Kamal is the brother of Leela. Leela is the mother of Nitin. How is Kamal related to Nitin?
questions.explanation: Kamal is the brother of Nitin's mother, so he is Nitin's maternal uncle.

questions.question_text: Ravi and Sita are full siblings. Ravi is the father of Arjun, and Sita is the mother of Beena. How are Arjun and Beena related?
questions.explanation: Arjun is the child of Ravi and Beena is the child of Ravi's full sister Sita. Children of siblings are first cousins.

questions.question_text: Neha is the mother of Pooja. Pooja is married to Karan. How is Neha related to Karan?
questions.explanation: Neha is the mother of Karan's wife, so Neha is his mother-in-law.

questions.question_text: A woman’s brother has a daughter, and that daughter has a son, R. How is R related to the woman?
questions.explanation: The woman's brother's daughter is her niece. That niece's son is her great-nephew (also called a grandnephew).

questions.question_text: J is married to K. L is K's sister. L is the mother of M. How is L related to J?
questions.explanation: L is the sister of J's spouse K, so L is J's sister-in-law.

questions.question_text: N is the sister of M. M is the father of P and is married to L, P's mother. How is N related to P?
questions.explanation: M is P's father and N is M's sister. Thus N is P's paternal aunt.

questions.question_text: P is the brother of Q. Q is the father of R. R is the mother of S. How is P related to S?
questions.explanation: P is the brother of S's maternal grandfather Q. Q is R's father, and R is S's mother. So P is the brother of S's mother's father.

questions.question_text: E is the mother of A. A is the father of B. B and C are full siblings. C is the father of D. How is E related to D?
questions.explanation: A is C's father because B and C are full siblings. E is A's mother, C is D's father, so E is D's paternal great-grandmother.

questions.question_text: The symbols mean: A+B: A is the father of B; A−B: A is the mother of B; A×B: A is the sister of B. How is P related to S in P×R−B+S?
questions.explanation: P is R's sister, R is B's mother, and B is S's father. Therefore P is the sister of S's father's mother: S's father's maternal aunt.

questions.question_text: A is the brother of B. B is the mother of C. C is the father of D. E is the sister of A. Assume A and B, and A and E, are full siblings. How is E related to D?
questions.explanation: E is A's sister and A and B are full siblings, so E is also B's sister. B is C's mother, and C is D's father. Thus E is the sister of D's paternal grandmother: D's father's maternal aunt.
